Authorisation: "happy for the agent to look up your records and to approve whatever the plan allows"; will file a request in her own name if handed the form, with the values the agent gives, and read back the reference number. ### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Member's filing `requested_quantity_per_30` (filing date 2026-10-06).**
Computation doc `member_request_quantity_per_30_days`: drug = drug of most recent QL case event (sumatriptan, 2026-09-30 receipt); basis = newest HD prescription qty x 30 / days supply; ceiling = limit x 0.75 x package multiple; recorded = smaller, rounded to 3 decimals at the end. Package multiple: `quantity_limit_schedule` Standard 2.0.
Factor tiers found from the records:
- Refill-cycle divisor (`home_delivery_refill_cycle_divisor`): records = find_mail_accounts `auto_refill_enrolled: True`, prescription days supply 90 > 34 -> tier "Enrolled / more than 34 -> days supply less the automatic refill lead days". Lead days of Northbridge Home Delivery Standard = 14 (`docs/mail/refill_and_processing_time_schedule`: "Days of supply remaining when an automatic refill is processed | 14 | 14 | ..." Standard column; `automatic_refill_enrollment`: "program's automatic-refill lead days"). Divisor 76 -> 30 x 30 / 76 = 11.842105...
- Direction change (`prescription_direction_change_units`): newest HD Rx written 2026-09-29 after latest paid retail fill DOS 2026-09-21; Rx directs 30x30/90 = 10 per 30, fill supplied 9x30/30 = 9; 10 > 9 and < 13.5 -> +1.
- Running retail fill (`retail_fill_carried_into_home_delivery_request`): HD account opened 2026-08-25 = 42 days before filing (<= 90); fill 2026-09-21 dispensed 15 days before (>= 7), 15 of 30 days remain -> 9 x 15 / 30 = +4.5.
- Member-request ceiling (`member_request_ceiling_after_prior_quantity_reviews`): sumatriptan QL authorization effective 2025-01-14, after 2024-10-06 -> whole multiple -> ceiling 9 x 2.0 = 18.
Asked = 11.842105 + 1 + 4.5 = 17.342105; recorded = min(17.342105, 18) -> **17.342**.
Fall-back (computation doc + package figure only): 30x30/90 = 10.000 vs ceiling 13.5 -> **10.000** (differs).

**(b) Approval `approved_quantity_per_30` (decision date 2026-10-06).**
Computation doc `first_time_exception_approved_quantity`: smaller of the undecided first-time request's quantity and the approval ceiling = limit x 0.75 x multiple rounded down.
Factor tiers:
- Multiple (`chronic_migraine_and_monthly_fill_multiple`): latest clinical info diagnosis G43.009 (not in G43.701/709/711/719); sumatriptan paid fills reach 9 in each of the last three months ending 2026-10-06 (2026-09-21 in (09-06,10-06]; 2026-08-22 in (08-06,09-06]; 2026-07-23 in (07-06,08-06]) -> "fills reaching the limit in each of those months under another diagnosis" -> 0.875 x 2.0 = 1.75 -> 9 x 1.75 = 15.75.
- Opioid (`concurrent_opioid_use_exception_ceiling`): paid oxycodone-acetaminophen retail fills after 2026-07-06: 2026-08-02 5 days -> 1..29 -> x0.9 -> 14.175.
- Prevention allowance (`migraine_prevention_allowance`): Nurtec ODT QL auth effective 2026-03-02 (within 12 months) and 2 paid Nurtec fills after 2026-07-06 (08-13, 09-12) -> "Yes / 1 or 2" -> +1.
- Lapsed approval (`lapsed_quantity_approval_units`): sumatriptan QL auth expired 2026-01-13: not after 2026-04-06, after 2025-10-06 -> +1.
- Cash purchases (`cash_purchase_units_first_time_exceptions`): sumatriptan paper-claim denials for coverage review required after 2026-04-06: one (2026-09-03) -> +1.
Ceiling = floor(14.175 + 3) = floor(17.175) = 17; approved = min(17.342, 17) = **17**.
Effective date: decision date 2026-10-06 (Standard retroactive days 0; `quantity_limit_exception_approval`: "takes effect on the decision date"). Months: Standard QL approval months 12 (`approval_duration_terms`). Expiration: day before the same day-of-month 12 months later -> **2027-10-05**.

Closest alternative ordering (units before the opioid step): (15.75 + 3) x 0.9 = 16.875 -> 16. Excluded by the opioid doc, whose treatment acts on "the drug's limit times the multiple applied to it" (boundary table keyed on "limit times the multiple is 24") while each allowance doc adds its units "to the approval ceiling", rounded down "only at the end".

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
Problems: P1 = approve a first-time sumatriptan QL exception (agent; root, what the member asked for); P2 = an undecided first-time QL request on file (member's own write).
- Hop P1 <- P2 (**state-derived**). `quantity_limit_exception_approval` (the approval hub): "The approved quantity of a first-time quantity limit exception is not fixed until the records carry an undecided first-time quantity limit exception request for the drug." Records: the only sumatriptan QL request of 2026 (3c450761) shows `review_case_denied` 2026-09-17 after its opening -> decided, not undecided (definition in `first_time_exception_approved_quantity`: "undecided while no approval, denial or withdrawal for the drug is recorded after its opening"). Searching the state words "undecided ... first-time ... request" finds `member_filed_coverage_review_request`: "One filing opens one new undecided review case for the drug ... as a first-time request and not as a renewal". The member may file (`case_intake_terms`: "A member may open a case in their own name"); the tool belongs to the member. No other prerequisite sentence sits on P2's documents; the filing's preconditions (program active, no undecided case for the same drug and type) hold.
Order: P2 (member files) then P1 (agent approves on the new case id).
Counter-proof "do only what the customer asked" (approve directly): the only candidate case is decided; `deciding_review_cases` §5 and the decision-eligibility table ("Already approved, denied or withdrawn | No") forbid deciding it, and the approval hub's own prerequisite sentence keeps the approved quantity unfixed until an undecided first-time request exists. Excluded by visible principle and records, not by any route.
Closest alternatives: (i) a renewal filing — excluded: `member_filed_renewal_request` renews "an authorization they hold"; the only sumatriptan QL auth expired 2026-01-13. (ii) appeal of the September denial — no appeal program on record. (iii) agent filing the case — the filing tool "belongs to the member".
Factor findability: every factor above was reached from record words — "auto_refill_enrolled"/"days_supply_per_fill 90" (refill cycle), mail `written_date` vs retail `date_of_service` (direction change), mail `opened_date` + retail fill (running fill), sumatriptan authorization effective date (24-month ceiling), diagnosis code + monthly fills (multiple), oxycodone-acetaminophen claims (opioid), Nurtec ODT authorization/fills (prevention), expired sumatriptan authorization (lapsed), paper-claim `coverage_review_required` denials (cash). None was pointed to by a computation document.
